description: Analyse a log of x402 payment attempts: settlement rate, every failure reason mapped to its cause, and whether any authorization was left unconsumed. When a payment log needs the failure mix and the settlement rate quantified. Do not choose this when you need on-chain verification of each payment, which needs the chain. Example requests: Why are my x402 payments failing? | Report the settlement rate of these payment attempts. | Which failure reasons dominate my payment log? | Are my payments settling reliably enough to depend on?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

attempts.description: The customer's attempts.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. Payment attempts with status and reason columns. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_settlement_reliability_report
title: Payment settlement reliability report
